_comment: PrecisionFit OpenLane2 config template (Week 4, optional). Copy/enable one of the configs_* entries per headline design: substitute DESIGN_NAME and VERILOG_FILES, keep every other field identical across the three runs so area/timing differences come only from the precision allocation. Run with: openlane synth/openlane_config.json --run-tag <tag>. Licensed Apache-2.0, see repo LICENSE.

configs_why.SYNTH_STRATEGY: AREA 0 makes Yosys/ABC optimize for area over speed, which is the metric being compared
configs_why.DIE_AREA: generous on purpose so placement congestion is not a confounder
configs_why.CLOCK_PERIOD: ONE shared period for all three, derived from the widest config (see synth/constraints.sdc)
